aurora_position: Aurora signed a friendly arrangement with Organigram on Nov 2 (announced Nov 3): C$7.80 per share in cash, 5.8626 Organigram shares, or C$3.75 plus 3.0431 shares, prorated, valuing Aurora at ~C$561M fully diluted; Aurora says that is a 21% premium to the Curaleaf bid's implied value. Aurora's board unanimously recommends not tendering to Curaleaf; Curaleaf says its bid remains open. Organigram deal needs holder votes by Dec 31 and is expected to close in Jan 2027; C$25.2M break fee payable by Aurora in specified cases
